verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling or recurring execution. Reverse ETL is described only as extracting warehouse data with a query and syncing it, with no schedule or recurrence mentioned. Functions and the Public API are building blocks or adjacent features, not documented job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
